title: Man and Older Woman Portrait, 1940s B&W Snapshot, 1947
description: A clear full-length outdoor portrait of a young dark-haired man in a striped button-down shirt standing alongside an older woman wearing glasses and a long wool coat. They are posing together on a residential sidewalk in front of a suburban lawn and houses. The photograph features a decorative deckle edge. The back bears a photo processing stamp reading '558E' and a handwritten date in pink ink reading 'June-47', capturing everyday life in post-World War II American suburbia.
